answer: Resist sybils with synthetic-control shocks. Each epoch a VRF draws a summit of seats and applies a private treatment — a short rate limit, an odd task mix, or an onyx-sealed fee tweak — while leaving matched untreated peers as the counterfactual baseline. Honest agents barely budge; a farm's clones echo one operator's scripted reaction, so their residuals move together. Peers compare treated-versus-control trajectories, and correlated outliers are merged and slashed. Extra keys cannot hide identical policy updates.
